review_locator: PMID:38825010, Polymerizing laminins in development, health, and disease; PMCID:PMC2811424, Laminin-binding integrins and their tetraspanin partners as potential antimetastatic targets
primary_title: Ligand-binding specificities of laminin-binding integrins: a comprehensive survey of laminin-integrin interactions using recombinant alpha3beta1, alpha6beta1, alpha7beta1 and alpha6beta4 integrins
decision_basis: The laminin reviews identify alpha7beta1 as a laminin receptor and cite the recombinant-integrin survey showing that laminin-411 binds alpha7X1beta1, albeit weakly.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the weak laminin-411 affinity and alpha7X1 splice-variant context; no generic laminin signaling or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMID:28245592, Role of Netrin-1 Signaling in Nerve Regeneration; PMID:33321883, CD146/sCD146 in the Pathogenesis and Monitoring of Angiogenic and Inflammatory Diseases
primary_title: CD146 acts as a novel receptor for netrin-1 in promoting angiogenesis and vascular development
decision_basis: The netrin-1/CD146 review literature cites the primary study demonstrating co-immunoprecipitation, direct purified-protein interaction, SPR affinity, CD146-dependent endothelial signaling, and angiogenic function.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CD146 as an endothelial receptor in the tested angiogenic context and distinguish it from UNC5B anti-angiogenic signaling; no SCI inference.

review_locator: PMID:16045811, The interaction of versican with its binding partners
primary_title: Binding of a large chondroitin sulfate/dermatan sulfate proteoglycan, versican, to L-selectin, P-selectin, and CD44
decision_basis: The versican interaction review cites the primary biochemical study demonstrating direct binding of versican to CD44 through versican chondroitin-sulfate chains and distinct sites from selectin binding.
limitations_preserved: Preserve chondroitin-sulfate-chain-mediated binding and proteoglycan glycoform context; no autonomous CD44 signaling or SCI inference.
